text: The Pellham Borough Council approved the harbour levy Tuesday night by a 19 to 6 vote, clearing the way for a new charge on commercial dock landings and vessel mooring fees starting Aug. 1. The measure is expected to raise about 1.4 million crowns a year for pier repairs, silt removal and lighting upgrades along the east basin. Councillors debated the proposal for nearly two hours before the roll call, with several opponents warning it could burden small operators. “This gives us a stable funding stream for work that has been overdue for years,” Council Chair Mara Elling said after the vote. Borough staff said billing notices will go out to berth holders next week.
